name: East Tennessee State University
tuition_note: In-state (TN resident) undergraduate tuition & fees 2026-27 = $11,468 (based on 15 credit hours) from etsu.edu/financial-aid-and-scholarships/cost/cofa.php. Housing room-only rate from etsu.edu/students/housing/ratesamenities.php: representative first-year standard double (Governors Hall) $3,415/semester x 2 = $6,830/year, Fall 2026/Spring 2027; rates exclude the required dining plan ($2,270/semester). Room rates vary by hall from ~$2,095 (West triple) to ~$4,100 (Centennial efficiency) per semester. The cost-of-attendance page only publishes a combined food+housing living estimate of $11,446, so the actual room-only rate is used here instead.
